title: I Took the Co-op Freezer Lock Through Three Inventory Nights Before I Dropped the Screenshots

parts.text: Night one the freezer lock code was on a sticky the treasurer said was temporary. I was forty-one, shift worker, holding a member key that still opened dry storage. At 9:18 p.m. the sticky opened meat and, I found, ice cream. Temporary, they said. I photographed the sticky, both doors, the time. Then a tote I did not recognize used the same code toward bulk cheese. I waited where the camera already was. If it is written, it can be applied to the person who wrote it.
parts.cliffhanger_hint: An unrecognized tote just used the sticky code toward bulk cheese.

social.video_title: They left the freezer code on a treasurer sticky — Part 1/3
social.description: Inventory night, a sticky, a tote toward cheese. Would you have followed the tote?

parts.text: Night two I followed with the stills. Cheese took the same four digits. The tote palmed bags that were not a count I could see from the camera. I was still forty-one, still on shift, suddenly the file. I added the stills to the inventory chat and asked for the lock log. The log showed the sticky used at 9:18 and 9:41. I forwarded the log to the board and put a hold on night three's count. I did not chase. I carbon-copied. The second photo is for the person who will say they never saw the first.
parts.cliffhanger_hint: The count is on hold and night three's lock is already at the board.

social.video_title: The log showed the sticky at 9:18 and 9:41 — Part 2/3
social.description: Bags off-count, a lock log, a held night. The board has the file. Does temporary still feel like ice cream?

parts.text: Night three ran on a rider: CODES CHANGE AFTER COUNT. Stickies came off. They recoded meat, ice cream, and cheese. I keep a member key that opens dry. Optics is a word treasurers use when a log exists. The lock survived three nights. The freezer finally costs what the count said, which is a kind of cheese. The room sounds like a room again, not a title. Petty is a word people use when their name is on the ticket.

social.description: Recoded doors, a rider, stickies off. Was temporary ever three nights?
